project.title: Bridge — Universal Local-to-Web AI Coding Harness Promo

scenes.title: Hook & The Copy-Paste Hell
scenes.voiceover: Be honest: how much time do you waste uploading code files to web AI chats, waiting for an answer, copy-pasting it back into your editor, and hitting immediate syntax errors? You copy the error, paste it back to the AI, get another half-baked snippet... and repeat this loop ten times in pure frustration. Stop copy-pasting code!

visual.description: Developer coding inside VS Code. File `auth-service.ts` has a nasty undefined error on line 42. Mouse cursor grabs `auth-service.ts` tab and drags it across into a Web AI chat prompt (Claude / ChatGPT style).

visual.promptText: Fix this authentication error and verify tests...

visual.description: Web AI assistant outputs a long 40-line snippet with a glowing 'Copy Code' button. Mouse clicks 'Copy Code', then alt-tabs furiously into the editor.
visual.aiMessage: Here is the updated function. Paste this into your file:

visual.description: Developer pastes code into IDE, opens terminal and executes `npm test`. BAM! Big red crash explosion: `TypeError: db.users.findOne is not a function`. The screen shakes.
errorOutput: ● TypeError: db.users.findOne is not a function

visual.description: High-intensity glitch transition. A montage of 5 error windows overlapping frantically. Suddenly screen flashes black and massive bold kinetic letters in blood red (#EF4444) slam onto screen: 'STOP COPY-PASTING CODE!' followed by an intense zoom-in.

scenes.title: The Solution — Meet Bridge
scenes.voiceover: Meet Bridge. The universal local-to-web AI coding harness. Built in high-speed LN4 Volt, Bridge connects your physical machine directly to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek via the Model Context Protocol. No port forwarding. Zero config files. Just run npx @markmayandi/bridge.

visual.description: Explosive bass drop transition from pitch black to electric LN4 Volt (#D2FF00). The iconic Bridge suspension wireframe illuminates with glowing catenary cables and central quantum node. Text scales in with sleek letter-spacing expansion.

acts.headline: HOW IT WORKS
acts.subheadline: Local Files ◄═══ Secure Anycast MCP ═══► Web AI Models

visual.description: Animated architecture diagram. On left: Local Workspace inside strict folder jail. In center: Cloudflare Anycast HTTPS quantum tunnel. On right: 4 AI Model badges (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) glowing in their signature brand colors.
Minimalist dark terminal window slides up. Glowing prompt with cursor types: `npm i -g @markmayandi/bridge` followed by subtitle: 'Or instant run with npx'. Verified green checkmark flashes.

scenes.title: Terminal Magic & Instant Tunnel
scenes.voiceover: Just open any project directory and type: bridge dot. In under two seconds, Bridge spins up a local sandboxed daemon, initiates an encrypted Cloudflare Anycast tunnel, and copies your live MCP URL straight into your clipboard. Look at that dashboard. Real-time folder jail enforcement, dynamic directory switching with key D, and live JSON-RPC traffic streaming with key L.

visual.description: In terminal, user types `bridge .` and presses Enter. The iconic Bridge ASCII wireframe suspension bridge boots up with a smooth Volt green progress bar charging from 0% to 100%.

Live Cloudflare Anycast URL illuminates in Cyan (#50C8FF): `https://quantum-edge-842.trycloudflare.com/mcp`. Floating toast notification pops in top-right: '✓ [COPIED] MCP URL loaded into your clipboard!' with glowing clipboard icon.
visual.toast: ✓ [COPIED] MCP URL loaded into your clipboard!

visual.description: Highlights 4 interactive hotkey cards: [C] Re-copy MCP URL, [D] Switch project folder in-terminal, [L] Toggle live JSON-RPC traffic, [Q] Quit & clean ports. Highlights 'JAILED: STRICTLY ENFORCED' security badge.

scenes.title: Web Chat Connection & Permission Prompt
scenes.voiceover: Now switch to your web AI client. In Claude or ChatGPT, open Custom MCP tools and paste your Bridge URL. In a split second, connection succeeds with seven native tools ready. Type your prompt: at bridge, fix the auth token validation bug in server.js and run the test suite. Bridge presents an explicit security permission dialog showing the exact files and commands requested. Click Allow.

visual.description: Sleek Claude/ChatGPT web UI interface. User clicks 'Add Custom MCP Server'. Modal dialog smoothly expands with dark backdrop blur.
visual.field2: URL input field glowing in LN4 Volt

visual.description: Ctrl+V paste animation: `https://quantum-edge-842.trycloudflare.com/mcp` fills the input with 'PASTED' tag. Click 'Connect Server'. Status instantly changes to glowing green dot: 'Connected (7 Tools Ready: read, edit, pwsh, bash, jobs, plan)'.

In chat input, user types `@bridge` which highlights in bold LN4 Volt, followed by prompt text: 'fix the auth token validation bug in server.js and run the test suite'. User hits Send. AI begins reasoning.
visual.promptText: @bridge fix the auth token validation bug in server.js and run the test suite

visual.description: Security modal slides in: 'Bridge is requesting permission to execute: edit_file(server.js) & pwsh(npm test) on your local workspace'. Mouse cursor hovers over the glowing LN4 Volt button '[Allow for Session]' and clicks it.

scenes.title: Live Execution, Test Victory & Viral CTA
scenes.voiceover: Watch this happen in real time. The web AI calls tools over the Anycast tunnel. Bridge reads the file locally, applies atomic replacements, and executes powershell tests directly in your machine. Look at the terminal: all fourteen tests pass in 320 milliseconds! No copying, no pasting, no context loss. Bridge turns every web AI into a full-stack local coding agent. Install it today with npx at markmayandi slash bridge or star us on GitHub!

visual.description: Split visual. Top: Web chat showing live tool call badges ('Reading server.js...', 'Editing server.js...', 'Running pwsh npm test...'). Bottom: Bridge terminal streaming live JSON-RPC traffic lines in cyan and volt. File diff flashes with green lines of verified code.

Terminal outputs: '✔ 14 passing (0 failing) [320ms]' in brilliant electric green. Web AI outputs: 'All tests pass on your machine!'. Big neon green celebration ring bursts across screen. The developer is completely hands-free.

Grand finale outro card. Giant glowing Bridge icon in center. Feature pills orbiting: 'Strict Folder Jail', 'Zero Open Ports', 'Works on Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek'. Big terminal pill with copy command: `npx @markmayandi/bridge`. GitHub star badge with golden star icon.
